name: atlas-developers
description: Atlas Developers — tools for the work behind the money. A product of Atlas Financial.

scripts.check: bash -n install.sh && bash -n scripts/install.sh && node cli/test.js
scripts.pack:npm: mkdir -p dist/npm && npm pack ./core --pack-destination dist/npm && npm pack ./cli --pack-destination dist/npm && npm pack ./npm/gui --pack-destination dist/npm
scripts.pack:deb: bash packaging/build-deb-cli.sh amd64 dist/packages && bash packaging/build-deb-cli.sh arm64 dist/packages
scripts.publish:npm: npm publish ./core --access public && npm publish ./cli --access public && npm publish ./npm/gui --access public
